notes.title: May 9 Patch Details
notes.content:
Fixed a bug in the Nikko Archangel vs Nasu Archangel battle where the game crashed

Fixed a bug where the Brillonian King's ranged power in the Modified Goblin battle caused the game to crash

Fixing the bug where the game would not save in the start menu

New way to save the game within the mission, now you can save the game with the J key.

New way to exit the game when playing a mission, press the F key and then on the name EXIT

notes.title: Big update on May 9th
notes.content:
May 9 update what's next:
Fixes bugs where the game crashes in the Nikko Archangel vs Nasu Archangel battle
New 6 languages (there will be more languages in future updates)
Fix on the power of the Shining King in the fight against the Goblin Witch

What will come in the future?
An open world mode, where you can explore the Shining Kingdom with Nikko Sasaki, do quests, talk to NPCs, defeat monsters.
There will be a mode called Archangels vs Demons, which will tell the story of Nikko Archangel
